svg.title: Flagship workflow: Gmail to Sheets to HTML to Telegram
svg.desc: An order email is extracted by an agent, validated in code and routed by confidence. Low confidence waits for approval in the console. The order is appended to Sheets once, rendered as HTML, sent to Telegram, and the email is labelled processed.

g.font-family: Switzer, Inter, 'SF Pro Text', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: WRITE AND TELL, RIGHT TO LEFT
The agent only extracts. Code checks the numbers, a person approves low confidence, and every write happens in a deterministic action step.
Source: workflows/gmail-orders.yaml. Setup steps such as configuration and header checks are left out.
